name: Essentials of Christ Mission
tagline: Jesus Christ the Way, the Truth and the Life
description: Essentials of Christ Mission (ECM) is a Christ centred church in Lashibi, Tema, Ghana. Join us for worship, the Word and fellowship.

theme.headline: Our Year of Increase & Expansion
theme.scriptureText: Enlarge the place of your tent, stretch your tent curtains wide, do not hold back; lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes. For you will spread out to the right and to the left.

contact.mapQuery: Essentials of Christ Mission, Lashibi, Tema

welcome.heading: You are welcome home
welcome.message: Welcome to Essentials of Christ Mission. We are a family that believes the teachings of Jesus Christ are the foundation of every Christian life. Whether you are new to faith or have walked with God for years, there is a seat for you here. Come as you are, worship with us, grow in the Word and discover the life Jesus offers.

outreach.title: Go Ye Train
outreach.subtitle: Annual outreach to Akuse Prisons
outreach.text: Every year our Evangelism Ministry boards the Go Ye Train to Akuse Prisons, bringing the gospel, prayer, food, toiletries and encouragement to inmates and officers. For four years running, God has used this outreach to restore hope and transform lives. You can be part of the next journey.

give.intro: Thank you for partnering with us to spread the gospel and serve our community. Every gift, big or small, helps us reach more people with the love of Jesus.
give.scripture: Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver. 2 Corinthians 9:7
give.reference: Please use your name and the purpose of your gift (for example Tithe, Offering, Evangelism) as the reference.
